products.title: Approved Refurbished SmartPower Battery V3
products.body_html:
Approved Refurbished SmartPower Battery V3 - Designed to fit the Q Series and VERTX Remote.

Approved products may show signs of use, however each battery must pass our rigorous testing process before getting the Stewart stamp of approval. All approved used batteries are guaranteed to have over 90% capacity and come with a 1-year warranty.

    Our SmartPower battery slots straight into the chassis and connects automatically. There are no leads, no clips and no fiddling on the first tee. Pair it with the free SmartPower app over Bluetooth and you can check your remaining charge from your phone at any point in the round, so you can get on with your game.

    Choose your capacity

    Base, 230Wh. Our everyday battery for the regular 18-hole golfer. Across more than 600 test rounds, in every weather and course condition, with a 14kg bag, the average round used 135Wh. That leaves Base with plenty in reserve for a full 18 holes. At 2.5kg, it is also our lightest option.

    Max, 307Wh. For the golfer who plays long, plays often, or plays 36. Max gives you over a third more capacity than Base, enough for a double round in normal conditions, with extra headroom on hilly courses, heavy ground or cold winter days. Max is also the kinder choice for frequent players: working the cells less deeply on each round helps preserve long-term battery health.

    Built on LiFePO4

    SmartPower uses lithium iron phosphate (LiFePO4) cells, a chemistry chosen for stability and lifespan. Each battery is tested for more than 2,000 charge cycles. An integrated cell management system balances and protects every cell, so your battery delivers consistent power from the first hole to the last, round after round.

    Key features
    • Designed for every Q Series and VERTX Remote trolley
    • Automatic plug-and-play connection, no leads or cables
    • Live battery monitoring via the SmartPower app (Bluetooth)
    • LiFePO4 lithium cells, tested for 2,000+ charge cycles
    • Integrated cell management system
    • Bespoke case, identical footprint for Base and Max
    • Two capacities: 230Wh (Base) or 307Wh (Max)

    Specifications

      Base Max
    Capacity  230Wh 307Wh
    Typical range* 18 holes Up to 36 holes
    Weight 2.5kg 3.0kg
    Size 11 x 12 x 29cm 11 x 12 x 29cm
    Chemistry LiFePO4 LiFePO4
    App monitoring Yes Yes
    Warranty 12-Months 12-Months

     
    Compatibility:
    Q Follow, Q Follow Carbon Range, The Open Collection and VERTX Remote. Not compatible with V10 trolleys.

    Charger not included. Your trolley's original SmartPower charger works with both Base and Max.

    Getting the most from your battery: charge fully after every round, avoid storing it in extreme temperatures, and don't overload your bag.

    *Just like an electric car, your battery's range will vary. Typical ranges are based on an average of 135Wh per round across 600+ test rounds with a 14kg bag. Heavier bags, hilly or long courses, soft or wet ground, and cold weather all require more power and will reduce the number of holes per charge. Battery capacity reduces naturally over time.

products.title: X Series & V10 Remote Umbrella Holder
products.body_html:
This umbrella holder is designed for use with both the X Series Electric Golf Trolley (of any age), F Series and V10 Remote trolley.


When used with the F Series, the umbrella holder simply screws into the thread location already on the handle.

For use with the V10 Remote, X1, X3, X5, X7, X9 or X10, fit the black ball into the centre ball holder location (this is secured in place by a backing plate and screw). This black ball can be left in place at all times as it only takes up the same amount of space as a golf ball. Once in place, the umbrella holder can be fitted in just a few seconds.

When the umbrella is in place, hook the elastic loop over the top of the handle.

The internal diameter of the umbrella holder is 40mm and the depth 130mm. Please check your umbrella will fit this prior to ordering.

PLEASE NOTE:

This umbrella holder is not designed to hold an umbrella while the trolley is in motion, indeed for many users it will be too low to achieve this. It is designed as a place to put an umbrella while you take a shot.

This is a safety precaution designed to remove the chance of the trolley becoming unstable when used in windy conditions, as a remote control or follow machine could be a distance away from the user when in motion.

products.title: X Series Lithium Battery (22Ah)
products.body_html:
The lithium battery that is supplied as standard with the X7 Lithium, X9, and X10 can be used with X-Series trolleys of all ages. Now you can swap your old heavy lead-acid battery for a lightweight lithium version.

The Lithium Phosphate 22Ah can be used in any X Series (X1, X3, X5, X7, X9 or X10). There are no electronics changes or adjustments necessary; you can just start using the new battery as a direct replacement.

The battery is protected by a sophisticated battery management system (BMS) that constantly monitors every cell to ensure the battery is always optimised for best performance and life. It is supplied complete with battery lead and protective neoprene case. You will note that the lithium battery is supplied with blue/black connectors, whereas your trolley may be fitted with red/black connectors. This change has been made to emphasise the importance of using the correct battery charger with this battery - using the wrong charger could damage the battery.

WARNING:
DO NOT USE A LEAD-ACID CHARGER WITH THIS BATTERY. ONLY USE THE CORRECT CHARGER AS SUPPLIED BY STEWART GOLF. (THE LITHIUM BATTERY CAN ONLY BE CHARGED WITH THE BATTERY CHARGER THAT HAS THE BLACK/BLUE OR BLACK/RED TORBERRY CONNECTORS). IF IN ANY DOUBT PLEASE CONTACT US.

The charger is not included but can be purchased separately.

Stewart Golf 22Ah Battery Specification:

  • Type: LiFePO4 (Lithium Phosphate)
  • Voltage: 12.8 Volts nominal, 14.4 Volts fully charged
  • Capacity: 22 Amp hour
  • Energy: 316 Watt-hours
  • Size: 188mm x 160mm x 75mm (7.4" x 6.3" x 2.9")
  • Weight: 2.9Kg (5.7lb)
  • Life: More than 1000 cycles (see below)
  • Warranty: 1 year
  • Management: Internal integrated cell management system
  • Connection: Torberry
  • Accessories: Quality fitted soft-touch protection bag


Charger: Input 100/240V, 50/60 Hz, Output 14.6V, 5 Amp
Charge Time: Up to 5 hours
Size: 155mm x 70mm x 50mm ( 6.1" x 2.7" x 2.0")

  • In laboratory conditions over 1000 simulated charge cycles, the battery will retain at least 80% of its capacity.
  • The battery can be expect to lose 2-3% capacity per year through cell degradation, compared with a lead/acid battery which can lose 8-9% per year.
  • During testing of the battery with the Stewart Golf X-Series, its average use was 12-15Ah of the 22Ah battery per round of golf.

 

WARNING:
We recommend that only an official Stewart Golf battery is used because other non purpose units may cause damage to your trolley and will therefore void any warranty.
User must charge battery with Stewart Golf charger to avoid the risk of damaging cells which will also void any warranty.

products.title: X Series Extended Capacity Lithium Battery (30Ah)
products.body_html:
The new Extended Capacity lithium battery offers a 30% increased size on the standard lithium battery.

The Lithium Phosphate 30Ah battery can be used in any X Series (X1, X3, X5, X7, X9 or X10). There are no electronics changes or adjustments necessary; you can just start using the new battery as a direct replacement.

The battery is protected by a sophisticated battery management system (BMS) that constantly monitors every cell to ensure the battery is always optimised for best performance and life. It is supplied complete with battery lead and protective neoprene case.

You will note that the lithium battery is supplied with blue/black connectors, whereas your trolley may be fitted with red/black connectors. This change has been made to emphasise the importance of using the correct battery charger with this battery - using the wrong charger could damage the battery.

WARNING:

DO NOT USE A LEAD-ACID CHARGER WITH THIS BATTERY. ONLY USE THE CORRECT CHARGER AS SUPPLIED BY STEWART GOLF. (THE LITHIUM BATTERY CAN ONLY BE CHARGED WITH THE BATTERY CHARGER THAT HAS THE BLACK/BLUE OR BLACK/RED TORBERRY CONNECTORS). IF IN ANY DOUBT PLEASE CONTACT US.

The charger is not included but can be purchased separately. 

Is this a 36 hole battery?
We are unable to guarantee that this is a 36 hole battery, but it should be good for 36 holes based on our average measurements. During testing of the battery with the Stewart Golf X10, its average use was 12-15Ah of the battery per round of golf. However there are a number of variables that are in your control as the golfer that will effect consumption. The theory is no different to fuel consumption in a car. Your car may be able to make say 500 miles on a tank of fuel, but equally if it is driven inefficiently or loaded down, it may only achieve 300 miles sometimes.

18 holes of golf is not a finite measurement. There can be a difference of several miles from a short to a long course (taking the distance between green and tee in to account too).
Terrain, ground condition, bag weight, and a number of other factors can make a big difference. Imagine running along a flat concrete road as opposed to up a steep sand dune & you'll get the idea.
The quality of the golf also affects how far you walk. A golfer shooting 65 will walk a lot less than a golfer shooting 110 and zig-zagging up the fairways! This scenario would also see the steering being used more, which also consumes more power.


Stewart Golf 30Ah Battery Specification:

  • Type: LiFePO4 (Lithium Phosphate)
  • Voltage: 12.8 Volts nominal, 14.4 Volts fully charged
  • Capacity: 30 Amp hour
  • Capacity: 432 Watt-hours
  • Weight: 4Kg
  • Life: More than 1000 cycles (see below)
  • Warranty: 1 year
  • Management: Internal integrated cell management system
  • Connection: Output Torberry
  • Accessories: Quality fitted soft-touch protection bag


Charger: Input 100/240V, 50/60 Hz Output 14.6V, 5 Amp
Charger Time: Up to 7 hours
Size: 155mm x 70mm x 50mm ( 6.1" x 2.7" x 2.0")

In laboratory conditions over 1000 simulated golf cycles, the battery can be expected to lose 15% capacity.
The battery can be expect to lose 2-3% capacity per year through cell degradation, compared with a lead/acid battery which can lose 8-9% per year.
During testing of the battery with the Stewart Golf X Series , its average use was 12-15Ah of the battery per round of golf.


We recommend that only an official Stewart Golf battery is used because other non purpose units may cause damage to your trolley and will therefore void any warranty. The user must charge battery with Stewart Golf charger to avoid the risk of damaging cells which will also void any warranty.

products.title: Q & VERTX Services
products.body_html:
Packages
In response to customer demand, Stewart Golf have introduced a number of service packages to allow you to maintain Stewart Golf Machines. 


Fault Diagnosis

The trolley will be assessed by our service engineers and a report of the diagnosis provided together with a quote for work needed which will include parts and labour.

The diagnosis does not include any cleaning of the trolley.

Please note that this is for fault finding and repair only; this is not a service.

If a full service/valet is required, please book a Premier Service.

Premier Service 

Premier servicing of the Q Series includes full inspection of both front and rear axles, along with replacement wheel & axle bearings.

Our engineers will strip down and rebuild the motors, removing any accumulated carbon dust. 

Inspection of the brushes, lock ring & slider and gearboxes will be undertaken, with the gearbox being re-greased and brushes replaced if necessary. 

All Q Series will receive a replacement bag support, to the latest design. 

Battery Health Check

Included in your premium service

Our engineers will inspect your SmartPower battery and charger. Undertaking a full discharge and recharge capacity test, with any battery capacity above 80% being passed.

Any and all battery firmware will be updated. 

Handset Service

Included in your premium service

Our engineers will update your handset firmware to the latest available, ensuring the best performance out on the course. 

We will replace the handset battery, top and bottom mouldings, keypad, belt clip, silicon skin and USB charging cable.

Valet Clean

Included in your premier service

All components will be cleaned to our premium standards. Your trolley will be dismantled and each piece inspected, cleaned and reassembled. Including both rear and front wheels. 

After your service, we will contact you to update you on the condition of your Q Series and advise if we recommend any further work not covered by our service package. Any additional work you agree to go ahead with (while your trolley is still in our service centre) will not incur labour charges. You will receive a full service report of the work carried out on your Q Series, along with a short video of your trolley working to our engineers standards. 

POLITE NOTICE: We can only accept orders for service packages from UK mainland addresses.

products.title: SmartPower Lithium Battery
products.body_html:
Our SmartPower battery slots straight into the chassis and connects automatically. There are no leads, no clips and no fiddling on the first tee. Pair it with the free SmartPower app over Bluetooth and you can check your remaining charge from your phone at any point in the round, so you can get on with your game.

Choose your capacity

Base, 230Wh. Our everyday battery for the regular 18-hole golfer. Across more than 600 test rounds, in every weather and course condition, with a 14kg bag, the average round used 135Wh. That leaves Base with plenty in reserve for a full 18 holes. At 2.5kg, it is also our lightest option.

Max, 307Wh. For the golfer who plays long, plays often, or plays 36. Max gives you over a third more capacity than Base, enough for a double round in normal conditions, with extra headroom on hilly courses, heavy ground or cold winter days. Max is also the kinder choice for frequent players: working the cells less deeply on each round helps preserve long-term battery health.

Built on LiFePO4

SmartPower uses lithium iron phosphate (LiFePO4) cells, a chemistry chosen for stability and lifespan. Each battery is tested for more than 2,000 charge cycles. An integrated cell management system balances and protects every cell, so your battery delivers consistent power from the first hole to the last, round after round.

Key features

  • Designed for every Q Series and VERTX Remote trolley
  • Automatic plug-and-play connection, no leads or cables
  • Live battery monitoring via the SmartPower app (Bluetooth)
  • LiFePO4 lithium cells, tested for 2,000+ charge cycles
  • Integrated cell management system
  • Bespoke case, identical footprint for Base and Max
  • Two capacities: 230Wh (Base) or 307Wh (Max)

Specifications

  Base Max
Capacity  230Wh 307Wh
Typical range* 18 holes Up to 36 holes
Weight 2.5kg 3.0kg
Size 11 x 12 x 29cm 11 x 12 x 29cm
Chemistry LiFePO4 LiFePO4
App monitoring Yes Yes
Warranty 12-Months 12-Months
 
Compatibility:
Q Follow, Q Follow Carbon Range, The Open Collection and VERTX Remote. Not compatible with V10 trolleys.

Charger not included. Your trolley's original SmartPower charger works with both Base and Max.

Getting the most from your battery: charge fully after every round, avoid storing it in extreme temperatures, and don't overload your bag.

*Just like an electric car, your battery's range will vary. Typical ranges are based on an average of 135Wh per round across 600+ test rounds with a 14kg bag. Heavier bags, hilly or long courses, soft or wet ground, and cold weather all require more power and will reduce the number of holes per charge. Battery capacity reduces naturally over time.

  • With the trolley folded, place it upside down on a soft surface to avoid scratches.
  • Using a 3mm pin punch (with a flat end, do not use a pointed centre punch), knock out the old pin and remove the drive dog.
  • Align the new drive dog with the hole through the axle and motor stub axle, and drive through the new pin with a hammer. Be careful not to damage the motor with the hammer.

products.title: Bag Cushion
products.body_html:
Protect the cradle of your trolley from the damage that can be caused by the metal poppers on golf bags and give your bag an extra level of comfort with the X Series Bag Cushion.

Made from a silicone-based material, the bag Cushion secures to your X Series main support and provides a soft layer between your bag and trolley to also reduce movement and vibrations.

Fitting the Bag Cushion will require an electric drill and a 6mm drill piece.

Instructions (video below)

  1. Align the Bag Cushion on the main support ensuring it is seated correctly and centred. The angled edge should face upwards.
  2. Once you are happy the cushion is centred, use tape to secure its position.
  3. Lightly drill a marker through each hole of the Bag Cushion.
  4. Remove the Bag Cushion and using the markers you have just made, drill through. Do not drill deeper than 10mm to avoid damage to internal structures.
  5. Place Bag Cushion on the main support again. Align the holes to match and then secure the cushion using rivets provided.

products.title: X & V10 Services
products.body_html:
Available for X9, X10 & V10 models only.

Packages
In response to customer demand, Stewart Golf have introduced a number of service packages to allow you to maintain Stewart Golf Machines.

Fault Diagnosis - £60   *Please see carriage costs below

The trolley will be assessed by our service team and a report of the diagnosis provided together with a quote for work needed which will include parts and labour.

The diagnosis does not include any cleaning of the trolley.

Please note that this is for fault finding and repair only; this is not a service.

If a full service/valet is required, please book a Premier Service.

Premier Service - including valet - £169

This includes inspection of: chassis; rear wheels; handle; main support; rear cover; front cover; motors (including motor trim balancing) and front wheels; handset and the electronics system.

Drive dog & drive mould inspection. The motors will be stripped down and rebuilt and all carbon dust removed, brushes will be inspected.

In addition, the service will include: Handset service including; battery; top & bottom mouldings; switch membrane; belt clip replacement and silicone skin.

Also included is a battery and charger health check. This will include Inspection of the battery and charger plus full discharge and recharge to test battery capacity and readings.

This service is only available for Lithium batteries and chargers.

Valet clean - All removable covers will be cleaned and polished, the trolley will be dismantled and each piece inspected, the chassis will be cleaned and reassembled and both front and rear wheels cleaned and refitted.

Please return both your handset and battery (Lithium only) with the trolley.

 

After/during all of our services, we will contact you to advise on the condition of your product and advise if we recommend any further parts to be replaced (at additional cost). These will not incur labour cost whilst we have your product at our service centre. You will also receive a full report (Service Check List) of what has been checked and/or replaced, parts used and any recommendations, along with a short video showing your trolley working as it should.

Please note we are no longer able to provide service options for X1 - X7, or F1 models.

products.title: Q & X Series Wheel Set
products.body_html:
If you have a X3R or older trolley, you will need to order the conversion kit as this is required to fit the latest V3 wheel set.

To purchase a conversion kit, click here.

This new set of wheels uses a new manufacturing process which provides a durable non-metallic finish, and is used on all current production models.

Stewart Golf engineers worked to create a set of 4 wheels that would both reduce the weight and further improve the performance of both the Q Series and X Series trolleys.

The weight of the V3 wheel set has reduced dramatically by 30% from the previous model. This reduces the energy required to accelerate the wheel, and also the energy required to drive the trolley once in motion. The effect of this is a reduction in battery consumption which ultimately leads to more holes per charge.

Combine these efficiency gains with the greater traction & stability generated by the flatter profile, lateral tread design and tyre material, and the V3 wheels represent a significant leap forward in performance.

The quick release mechanism allows 'one handed' removal, with just one moving part. The front wheels are designed to match the rears, made from a material which slides laterally over the grass when you steer your X Series trolley.

Are the wheels easy to fit?
Rear wheels can be fitted easily using the quick release mechanism. The front wheels require a Torx / Allen Key and a pair of circlip pliers. The V3 wheels can not be fitted to the X1.

A competent engineer will be able to fit the front wheels. If you are not comfortable with this task then we are able to provide this service within the UK.

The conversion kit The conversion kit consists of replacement drive dogs for the rear wheels of the unit. Exisiting X3R trolleys come with a 2 tang drive dog which is not strong enough to support the motion of the new wheels. These will need to be replaced with the 4 tang drive dogs which will hold the wheels firmly in place. Please see the video below for instructions on how to replace the drive dogs.


Video
